title: otel/ adapter serves kbmon's metrics at /metrics on 127.0.0.1 only

gates.question: Which port does /metrics use when no port is given?
options: none: /metrics is served only when --prometheus-port is given
gates.recommendation: none: /metrics is served only when --prometheus-port is given
gates.answer: none: /metrics is served only when --prometheus-port is given
